title: Small Cap Watch: Explorers and developers advance key programs during June quarter
excerpt: The S&P/ASX Small Ordinaries Index (ASX) fell 57.70 points, or 1.73%, yesterday to close at 3,268.80. The index is now down 60.20 points, or 1.81%, over the...
content_html:
Proactive

Thu, July 30, 2026 at 7:34 PM EDT 4 min read

The S&P/ASX Small Ordinaries Index (ASX) fell 57.70 points, or 1.73%, yesterday to close at 3,268.80.

The index is now down 60.20 points, or 1.81%, over the past five trading sessions.

Despite the broader market weakness, small-cap companies continue to generate news across gold exploration, rare earths, helium, battery technology and biotechnology. You can read about the following and more throughout the day.

Ora Banda expands Little Gem mineralisation

Ora Banda Mining Ltd (ASX:OBM, OTC:ESGFF, FRA:M6N) reported further exploration success at its high-grade Little Gem prospect, where recent drilling expanded the mineralised footprint of the Sapphire lodes and delivered additional strong results from the Gem lodes.

New Gem intercepts included 18 metres at 3.4 g/t gold and 16.1 metres at 3.5 g/t, confirming the widths and grades seen in earlier drilling. The Gem lode system has now been defined across about 4.7 kilometres of strike and to roughly 750 metres below surface, with mineralisation remaining open.

More than 360 drill holes have been completed across Little Gem and Sunraysia, with Ora Banda targeting a maiden mineral resource estimate in late 2026.

Askari prepares for active African field season

Askari Metals Ltd (ASX:AS2, FRA:7ZG) continued to advance technical, logistical and stakeholder programs at the Nejo Gold-Copper Project in Ethiopia and the Uis critical metals project in Namibia during the June quarter.

The quarter was focused on consolidating exploration data and preparing for more active field programs designed to test priority targets, validate historical mineralisation and expand known mineralised corridors across both projects.

Altech secures extension for German grant conditions

Altech Batteries Ltd (ASX:ATC, OTC:ALTHF, FRA:A3Y) received an extension to the financial close deadline attached to potential German government funding for its CERENERGY® battery project.

The project has conditional approval for a grant covering about 30% of eligible capital expenditure, up to €46.7 million, under Germany's STARK economic development program.

The deadline to achieve full project financial close has been extended from June 30 to September 30, 2026.

Lindian advances Kangankunde development

Lindian Resources Ltd (ASX:LIN, OTC:LINIF) achieved further construction, operational and strategic milestones at the Kangankunde Rare Earths Project in Malawi during the June quarter.

The company progressed construction, mining readiness and operational preparations while continuing work on the Stage 2 definitive feasibility study, which is intended to support the project's longer-term expansion.

content_html_zh:
积极主动的

2026 年 7 月 30 日星期四，美国东部时间晚上 7:34 阅读 4 分钟

S&P/ASX 小普通股指数 (ASX) 昨天下跌 57.70 点，跌幅 1.73%，收于 3,268.80 点。

该指数在过去五个交易日中下跌了 60.20 点，跌幅为 1.81%。

尽管市场整体疲软，但小盘股公司继续在黄金勘探、稀土、氦气、电池技术和生物技术领域发布新闻。 您可以全天阅读以下内容以及更多内容。

Ora Banda 扩大 Little Gem 矿化

Ora Banda Mining Ltd（ASX：OBM，OTC：ESGFF，FRA：M6N）报告称，其高品位 Little Gem 矿区的勘探取得了进一步成功，最近的钻探扩大了蓝宝石矿脉的矿化足迹，并从宝石矿脉中获得了额外的强劲成果。

新的宝石截获量包括 18 米（3.4 克/吨）黄金和 16.1 米（3.5 克/吨）黄金，证实了早期钻探中看到的宽度和品位。 宝石矿脉系统现已确定，其走向长约 4.7 公里，深达地表以下约 750 米，矿化区仍处于开放状态。

Little Gem 和 Sunraysia 已完成 360 多个钻孔，Ora Banda 的目标是在 2026 年底进行首次矿产资源估算。

阿斯卡里为活跃的非洲野外季节做准备

Askari Metals Ltd (ASX:AS2, FRA:7ZG) 在六月季度继续推进埃塞俄比亚 Nejo 金铜项目和纳米比亚 Uis 关键金属项目的技术、物流和利益相关者计划。

本季度的重点是整合勘探数据并为更积极的现场计划做好准备，这些计划旨在测试优先目标、验证历史矿化并扩大两个项目的已知矿化走廊。

Altech 确保延长德国拨款条件

Altech Batteries Ltd（ASX：ATC，OTC：ALTHF，FRA：A3Y）收到了德国政府为其 CERENERGY® 电池项目提供潜在资助的财务截止期限的延长。

根据德国 STARK 经济发展计划，该项目有条件获得拨款，涵盖约 30% 的合格资本支出，最高可达 4670 万欧元。

实现项目全部财务结算的最后期限已从2026年6月30日延长至9月30日。

林甸推进康安昆德发展

Lindian Resources Ltd（ASX：LIN，OTC：LINIF）在六月季度在马拉维的 Kangankunde 稀土项目实现了进一步的建设、运营和战略里程碑。

该公司在继续进行第二阶段最终可行性研究的同时，推进了施工、采矿准备和运营准备工作，旨在支持该项目的长期扩张。
